name: Analyse Impulse Response
description: Analyse impulse response (IR) and return acoustic parameters such as EDT, T20, C50, etc., and its time and frequency responses for Plot 2D. Computed in the compas_acoustics worker.

outputParameters.name: parameters
outputParameters.description: List of acoustic parameters ('EDT', 'T20', 'T30', 'C50', 'C80', 'D50', 'DRR', 'Ts', 'STI', with its modulation transfer index per band, 'G', 'SPL', 'LF' and 'LFC'; G and SPL (the sound pressure level from the source's level at 1 m, overall A-weighted) only for a simulated response, LF and LFC, the early lateral energy fractions, only for an ambisonic one).

outputParameters.name: time
outputParameters.description: The impulse response against time, for Plot 2D or a panel: the W channel of an ambisonic response, both ears (left, right) of a binaural one. Right-click it to choose the scale: dB (default), the level re the peak floored 100 dB below it, the whole response; or linear, the amplitude: it ends 5 % after the Schroeder curve falls 60 dB, below which the amplitude is invisible. The parameters and the frequency output use the whole response.

outputParameters.name: frequency
outputParameters.description: The frequency response, 1/3-octave smoothed, 20 Hz to 20 kHz in dB re the peak, for Plot 2D or a panel: the W channel of an ambisonic response, both ears (left, right) of a binaural one.
